exact_conditional_one_shelf_per_cluster.null: Common iid Bernoulli large/small across note slots, conditioning on total large slots removes fitted p; assumes independent run clusters.

zero_violation_cluster_bound.note: One-sided binomial zero-event bound at run-cluster level; assumes independent sampled clusters, not a shelf-level bound. Bootstrap [1,1] for invariant events is descriptive only.

exclusion_audit.selection_rule: Exactly 8 parsed items; item is potential_drink or melody_of_*; quantity in 1/5/15; effective price belongs to externally specified price grid for its type and quantity. No check of discount count, half-price count, or count of large bundles is used for inclusion.

worst_case_large_any_identification.note: Treat every excluded shelf as unknown presence of a large bundle: lower assigns all zero, upper assigns all one. This is an identification interval, not a confidence interval.

sources: 客户端文本配置：SubNoteSkill.90011.1=强攻之音，对应音符90011。
既有价格核对确认的5枚音符包OCR连读修正规则：9045→45、9072→72；不按待检验的整架约束纳入样本。

exact_conditional_one_shelf_per_particip.selection: First normalized shelf for each participant in observations.jsonl file order, not chronological reordering.
exact_conditional_one_shelf_per_particip.null: Common iid Bernoulli large/small across note slots; conditional on the total large count.
exact_conditional_one_shelf_per_particip.scope: Only 18 observed participants; this sensitivity test does not identify broader player or server populations.

caveats: Intervals resample participant/session/run clusters; observation and preset selection are not population random sampling.
Generation IDs are local UI identities, not server IDs; content is never used to merge different generations.
First snapshot per generation is retained; later same-generation changes are counted, not treated as fresh shelves.
Tower/disc IDs and phase are not explicit shelf fields; preset/language strata cannot identify causal disc/tower dependence.
